# 10. 기능 카탈로그 (Feature Catalog)

quanta-codeagent-v3에 **구현·배선된** 기능 전수 목록. **대**(주요 시스템) → **중**(하위 능력) → **소**(구체 기능/노브) 3단.

근거: RFC `rfc/0001-architecture.md`, ADR `docs/decisions/0001~0027`. cross-import는 `@/agent`만(슬라이스 격리). 운영 reference: [docs/runbooks/agent-loop-reference.md](docs/runbooks/agent-loop-reference.md).

## 성숙도 5단계 척도

있다/없다 이분이 아니라 **구현 폐쇄도(closure)** 를 5단계로:

| 등급 | 의미 |
|---|---|
| **L5 ●●●●●** | 완성·검증 — 구현·배선·단위+통합테스트, **실 LLM 스모크 또는 e2e 폐쇄** 확인됨 |
| **L4 ●●●●○** | 견고 — 구현·배선·단위+통합테스트(실 runAgent, mock LLM). 실 LLM 스모크는 미실시 |
| **L3 ●●●○○** | 동작 — 구현·배선됨, **단위테스트 위주**(통합 미검증) |
| **L2 ●●○○○** | 부분/한계 — 동작하나 **의도적 제약·advisory·옵셔널 미도달** |
| **L1 ●○○○○** | 골격/보류 — **타입/API만 노출**, 루프 미배선, 의식적 후속 |

`⚙️` = env/config 노브(기본 OFF·behavior-preserving).

> **R-Phase1-4 closure (2026-05-21)** — 2-round 코드 audit(8 parallel agents) 후 correctness + observability + 정직성 일괄 폐쇄. **P0** (HIGH): streaming-dispatch 3개소 rejection 경로(`Promise.all` → `Promise.allSettled`, drainDeferredSlots try/catch, collectResultBlocks 합성 `dispatchFailedBlock`) — ordering invariant 회복; `maybeCompact()` try-catch + `error` 이벤트 + graceful degrade; `resolveMemoryContext()` 동등 처리. **P1** (MED): proactive compaction 성공 시 `recovery:{reason:"compact",detail:"proactive"}` 방출(reactive 대칭); `stream_reset` tombstone orphan promise `.catch(()=>{})` 가드(Bun unhandledRejection 방지); jsonl-recorder degraded-line 실패에 `logger.warn` 진단; streamingTurn `AbortSignal` 계약 docstring. **P3** (defensive): CLI 진입점 `process.on("unhandledRejection")` defense-in-depth; `HookBus.on` 제너릭 cast → closure-erasure(런타임 안전 + 타입 표면 개선); `WorkingMemory.snapshot` shallow-copy 명시(`WorkingState.snapshot`의 deep-copy와 구분). **P2** 회귀 테스트 6개 파일(40 신규 테스트): `streaming-dispatch-rejection-e2e`(4), `observability-error-event-e2e`(4 — P0-2/P0-3/P1-1 검증 + default-OFF 회귀 가드), `skill-discover-errors`(11), `lsp-bridge-probe`(3 — Promise.race 5s 타임아웃 + 캐시 + extension fast-path), `mcp-client-errors`(8 — empty command + not-running), `env-knob-branches`(35 — `pickProvider`/`buildStore`/`buildMemoryConfig`/`parseRecallTiers`/`buildSubagentConfig`/`buildVerifyGuardConfig`/`buildSkillsConfig` 전 분기). 모든 변경 default-OFF byte-identical 불변식 무손상.
>
> **R-Phase5 closure (2026-05-21)** — 또 2-round 코드 audit(8 parallel agents) 추가 진행 후 7건 fix + 7 regression test. **P0** (HIGH): (A) `features.cleanup` hook이 `loop.ts finish()` 어디에도 invoke되지 않아 background subagent 자식이 부모 abort 시 orphan — 5 finish 사이트 모두 cleanup invoke + try-catch(`error` 이벤트로 surface, default-OFF 시 optional chain 무동작). (B) `cacheConversationPrefix`가 마지막 블록이 `tool_use`/`tool_result`/`thinking`일 때 `cache_control`을 비-text 블록에 부착 (Anthropic API 무시 + 일부 버전에서 reject) — backward walk으로 last text 블록을 찾아 부착, text 블록 부재 시 graceful no-op. (C) `onConfirm` 콜백이 throw할 때 admissibility-gate가 propagate(2개소: HITL always-confirm 114, mode-policy ask 149) — try-catch로 wrap, `preview:"error"` 태그된 deny로 surface. **P1** (MED): (D) `HARD_DENY rm-recursive-force-system-root` 정규식 3개 `[\s\S]*?` lookahead unbounded ReDoS 위험 → `{0,500}?` 명시 bound(real bash command well under, adversarial 10KB+ input 100ms 미만 완료). (F) anthropic adapter `thinking_delta` explicit drain(Phase-1 intent 문서화). (G) FallbackLLM이 fallback provider가 zero event yield + prior partial 존재 시 stream_reset tombstone 누락 → for-await 외부에서 명시 emit. (H) `SqliteStore.save()` INSERT 동기 throw가 `Promise<void>` boundary를 우회 → try-catch + `Promise.reject(new Error("SqliteStore.save(<id>) failed: ..."))`. **회귀 테스트 7 파일(43 tests)**: `subagent-cleanup-invocation-e2e`(3), `anthropic-cache-control-blocks`(5), `onconfirm-throw`(5 — 3개 throw path + 2개 control), `hard-deny-redos-bound`(11 — positive/negative + 10KB adversarial timing < 100ms), `anthropic-thinking-delta`(4), `fallback-empty-tombstone`(4), `sqlite-save-error`(5). 모든 변경 default-OFF byte-identical 불변식 무손상(`features.cleanup?.()` optional chain, fallback의 prior-partial gate, etc.).
>
> **R-Phase6 catalog-truth pass (2026-05-21)** — 4-agent 병렬 audit 후 카탈로그 정직성 갱신. 코드 무수정, 카탈로그 갱신만:

JSON-RPC/stdio 경계의 untrusted-server CVE surface 폐쇄.

>
> **R-Phase7 fault-localization 도구 (2026-05-21)** — Agentless 3-stage(file→function→edit-location) funnel + codex-검증 신호 도구 흡수. **3-stage 구조 (Hybrid A+C, RFC §1.2 정합 — 신규 도구 0 for funnel, micro-FSM 회피)**: (A) `prompt.ts` tool routing matrix에 "localize a fault → localize/grep → read+lsp_document_symbol → lsp_references" 한 줄 추가; (C) `src/skill/system-skills/localize-fault/SKILL.md` 신설 — Stage1 FILE / Stage2 FUNCTION / Stage3 EDIT-LOCATION + outcome enum(`located`/`narrowed`/`uncertain`) + 4-truth-surface + 신호 위계("rg locates, source proves" — source text 10/10 > rg hits 5/10). `triggerLocalizeFault`/`findLocalizeFaultSkill`/`LOCALIZE_FAULT_SKILL_NAME` wiring seam(progress-audit 미러). **신규 도구 4종 (codex signal absorption, all read-only + concurrency-safe + MUTATING_TOOL_TABLE `null`)**: (1) `file_tree_summary` — depth-bounded .gitignore-respecting 디렉터리 트리 + per-dir 파일 카운트 (Stage-1 structure; codex file-topology 7/6); (2) `parse_test_failure` — pure 파서, raw 테스트/빌드 로그 → `file:line [framework]` 추출 (pytest/python-traceback/jest/vitest/bun/go-test/cargo; Stage-3, build-log 8/9 trust); (3) `git_churn` — 변경 빈도 hotspot 랭킹 (Stage-1 recency); (4) `git_blame_heatmap` — per-author 라인 ownership 분포 (Stage-1 ownership). defaultTools에 `file_tree_summary`+`parse_test_failure` 등록(byte-identical: 미호출 세션 무변경), gitTools 6→8(`QUANTA_GIT_TOOLS` opt-in 유지). **회귀 테스트 5 파일(약 70 tests)**: `skill-localize-fault`(frontmatter+3-stage body+wiring), `file-tree-summary`(트리/depth/cap/jail), `parse-test-failure`(6 framework + dedup + reject), `git-churn-blame-heatmap`(pure rank + tool 양면), `prompt-system` routing 단언 추가. **통합 가드 수정**: `MUTATING_TOOL_TABLE`(mode.ts) 4 entry(전부 read-only `null`), git-tools barrel count 6→8 단언. 모든 변경 default-OFF byte-identical 불변식 무손상.
>
> **R-Phase7b system-skills 런타임 배선 (2026-05-21)** — localize-fault/progress-audit 스킬이 만들어졌지만 `config.skills`가 `{ dir: string }` 필수라 `QUANTA_SKILLS_DIR` 미설정 시 **루프에서 도달 불가**였던 갭 폐쇄(ADR-0045 "유저가 env var 기억 안 해도 discipline 스킬은 available" 약속 위반). 수정: (1) `AgentConfig.skills.dir`를 optional로 (`{ dir?: string; changedPaths?: string[] }`); (2) `buildSkillFeatures`가 dir 부재 시 user 스킬 discovery 스킵 + bundled system 스킬만 로드; (3) CLI `buildSkillsConfig` 3-state — `QUANTA_SKILLS_DIR=<path>`→`{dir}`(user+system), `QUANTA_SKILLS=1`/`--skills`→`{}`(system only), 둘 다 없으면 `undefined`(byte-identical OFF). 이제 `QUANTA_SKILLS=1`만으로 localize-fault+progress-audit 즉시 invocable. 스킬 ABSENT 세션은 여전히 Skill 도구 미등록(RFC §1.2 무손상). 회귀 테스트: `features.test.ts`에 `skills:{}`→bundled 양쪽 discovered + ABSENT→no Skill tool 단언, `env-knob-branches`에 3-state 분기.
>
> **R-Phase8 fault-localization 도구 품질 강화 (2026-05-21)** — R-Phase7 도구 4종 비판적 audit 후 진짜 품질 갭 4건 구조적 폐쇄. **#1 `parse_test_failure` vendored 필터 + user-code-first 랭킹** (최고 레버리지): `FrameTier`(user>test>vendored) + `classifyFrame`(node_modules/.pnp/site-packages/.venv/.cargo/vendor/dist/build/target) + TEST_FILE 휴리스틱. tier-우선 정렬(동률 시 discovery 순) + **랭킹 후 cap** → vendored flood가 user 프레임을 max_results 밖으로 못 밀어냄(codex build-log 8/9 trust). **#2 probe 3-stage funnel 측정 장치** (honesty loop): `apps/probe/funnel.ts` `observeFunnel`/`renderFunnel` + `probe --funnel` — trajectory tool_call 시퀀스에서 file→function→edit-location **monotonic** 진행 관찰, NON-authoritative(낮은 stage는 결함 아님). R-Phase7이 약속한 "probe trace 측정"을 실제 구현 → 옵션 B 승격 근거(RFC §9.1). **#3 `file_tree_summary` purpose layer**: `summarize:true` → `rg -m1` 두 번째 패스로 파일별 첫 선언/주석 추출 + ` — <hint>` 주석(200파일 cap, 80자 truncate, 실패 시 구조-only degrade). **#4 `git_blame_heatmap` line-range**: `start_line`/`end_line` → `git blame -L`로 함수 단위 ownership, zod refine으로 paired+ordered 강제. **회귀 73 tests/5 files green**. 의도적 보류: 옵션 B `localize_hierarchical`(micro-FSM, funnel 데이터 보고 결정), embedding search, AST fallback. read-only + concurrency-safe + byte-identical.
>
> **베이스라인 주의 (R-Phase7~8 시점)** — 본 단락 작성 시점 repo는 다수 외부 병렬 WIP(Wave A ReviewerPort, ADR-0030 mid-turn steering, Wave D vocabulary, apps/cli/slash-commands `process.env`)로 인해 full `bun test`에 ~58개 외부 failure가 존재(R-Phase7~8 추가와 무관 — 본 도구/스킬/배선/강화 테스트는 전부 green, MINE-related failure 0 확인 + 외부 `apply_patch` MUTATING_TOOL_TABLE 누락도 함께 수정해 공유 drift gate 회복). 따라서 `refresh-baseline.ts` 실행을 의도적으로 보류(외부 WIP failure를 baseline으로 기록하지 않기 위함). 베이스라인 수치는 외부 WIP 안정화 후 갱신 예정 — 위 R-Phase6 수치(205 files)는 R-Phase7(도구 4 + 스킬 1 + 배선) + R-Phase8(품질 강화 4 + probe funnel) 추가분을 미반영.

Gap-1 — Provider refusal/abnormal stop: decideOnAssembled에 stopReason==="refusal" 신규 브랜치(max_tokens / tool_use / empty 앞) → terminal {do:"error", reason:"Model refused to continue …"}, outputContinues / malformedRetries / consecutiveEmpties 미소비. pre-ADR fall-through는 refusal 텍스트를 정상 completion으로 위장(가장 ROI 높은 fix). pause_turn / content_filtered / guardrail_intervened는 dead code 회피 — 서버 도구 / Bedrock guardrail 흡수 시 재평가. Gap-2 — Reasoning/thinking carry-over: StreamEvent에 thinking_delta + signature_delta 추가, assembleFromEvents가 연속 delta를 1 ThinkingBlock으로 fold + signature를 last ThinkingBlock에 부착, 어시스턴트 메시지 prepend로 provider order(thinking before text/tool_use) 보존. Anthropic SSE / OpenAI reasoning summary 어댑터 emit. multi-turn carry-over는 자동 — ThinkingBlock이 메시지에 타고, wm.append → 다음 턴 StreamInput.messages → 어댑터가 wire 형식으로 재직렬화. Gap-4 — deny_and_steer verb: ConfirmDecision discriminated union {allow\|deny\|deny_and_steer{steer}} + AgentConfig.onConfirm 시그니처 확장 + normalizeConfirm bridge(boolean ↔ ConfirmDecision, 레거시 caller byte-identical). admissibility-gate의 always-confirm 브랜치가 deny_and_steer 시 deny DispatchResult를 emit하면서 steer를 result envelope steerInjection?: string에 attach. Gap-3 — Submission op dispatcher: 6-variant union shape는 존재하나 entry-point 분기는 deferred (loop.ts 동시 co-development 회피). Gap-5 — Refusal in-stream tool short-circuit (self-audit follow-up, 2026-05-22): streamingTurn의 Phase 3 (drainDeferredSlots — barrier-blocked unsafe tool dispatch)가 `stopReason === "refusal"`이면 SKIP. 자체 audit 발견 — 기존 Gap-1은 `decideOnAssembled`(post-stream)에서만 단락하므로 mid-stream tool_use 가 deferred slot으로 들어간 후 message_stop=refusal이 와도 bash가 실제로 실행되었음(smoke 15-refusal-mid-tool가 매 CI run마다 `echo malicious` 실행). Phase 4는 dispatched slot(promise!==undefined)만 collect — orphan tool_use 블록은 message.content에 남지만 runStep의 error 분기가 wm.append 없이 즉시 종료하므로 carry-over 오염 없음. byte-identical: non-refusal 경로 변화 0. Hell-gate hardening (181 hell case + 2 e2e smoke): 6 신규 hell-test file이 3개 추가 invariant를 PIN — (i) signature_delta가 thinking_delta 없이 도착하면 ThinkingBlock 합성하지 않고 silently drop (orphan은 후속 thinking에 back-attach 안 함), (ii) ConfirmDecision normalize는 `{__proto__:{decision:"allow"}}`형 prototype-pollution 입력에 대해 보호적으로 deny로 narrow, (iii) OpenAI content_filter finish_reason은 last-wins. 부분 와이어링(steerInjection emit OK / loop consumer 미연결)은 G-1~G-1d 4-test partial-wiring guard로 파일 grep 기반 regression pin — 향후 wiring PR이 guard를 의식적으로 갱신하지 않으면 자동 실패. · src/agent/loop.ts, src/agent/confirm-decision.ts · ADR-76 · 17u/5i<br>**소유자**: @songmin<br>**Labels**: surface:core · tier:core<br>**의존**: agent-types-split, fallback-kinds-policy, llm-factory, model-swap-retry, plan-mode<br>**UI**: cli<br>**Monitoring**: integrated · keys: gen_ai.response.time_to_first_token_ms, quanta.conversation.id, quanta.hitl |

(2) Sort rules by prefix length DESCENDING; stable order preserved for equal-length prefixes via original index — matcher is a total deterministic function of (command, rules). (3) For each rule (longest first) accept iff `command === rule.prefix` OR `command.startsWith(rule.prefix) AND command[rule.prefix.length] === ASCII 0x20`. (2) `McpClient` — protocol version `"2025-06-18"`, `CLIENT_INFO` { name:"quanta", version:"0.1.0" }, default request timeout 30s, four lifecycle methods (`initialize` / `tools/list` / `tools/call` / `shutdown`). | 권한·안전 — glob matching (Cursor .mdc / Claude paths: 흡수) | ReDoS-hardened glob DP matcher (skill activation + Cursor rule paths) | **L4** `[B]` | Memoized dynamic-programming glob matcher for the constructs Claude Code's `paths:` and Cursor `.cursor/rules` `globs:` use: `**` (any chars incl. `/`, with an optional following `/` convenience), `*` (any run of non-`/`), `?` (one non-`/`), literals. A pattern without a `/` matches a path's basename at any depth (gitignore semantics). NOT regex by design: glob patterns come from attacker-influenceable frontmatter, and the obvious `**`→`.*` translation produces multiple unbounded `.*` quantifiers — a pattern like `**/x/**/x/**/x` compiles to `.*x/.*x/.*x` and catastrophically backtracks (O(nᵏ)) on a long NON-matching path, hanging the whole agent (DoS). JS lacks atomic groups / possessive quantifiers, so the matcher uses a memoized DP instead: every (token, position) pair is decided at most once → hard O(tokens · len²) ceiling with no exponential blowup. Hard caps on inputs: `MAX_GLOB_LEN = 4096`, `MAX_PATH_LEN = 8192`, combined work-budget `MAX_GLOB_WORK = 1 << 20` (tokens × len product). Over-cap inputs short-circuit to no-match (safe failure mode — a malicious oversized glob/path simply never matches). Used by skill activation (paths trigger) and Cursor rule path-matching. · src/skill/activation.ts, src/agent/glob-rules.ts · 4u/1i<br>**소유자**: @songmin<br>**Labels**: absorbed:cursor · surface:cli · tier:1<br>**의존**: rules-matcher, glob-rules<br>**UI**: cli |

| memory — pure vector primitives | Memory vector math — pure cosine / dot / normalize + Float32 serde | **L4** `[B]` | Pure vector math + (de)serialization for semantic recall. Zero deps: a Float32 little-endian buffer is the on-disk form (the SQLite embedding column is a BLOB), the in-memory form is a plain `number[]`. Shared by both memory adapters and the ranking layer so similarity semantics never diverge between InMemoryStore and SqliteStore. `dot(a, b)` returns 0 on length mismatch (treated as "incomparable"). `cosine(a, b)` returns 0 — never NaN — when either vector is empty, zero-magnitude, length-mismatched, or contains a non-finite component, so ranking stays total and deterministic. `normalize(a)` returns a zero/empty vector unchanged. `serializeVec` / `deserializeVec` round-trip the Float32 little-endian BLOB form. · src/memory/vector.ts, src/memory/dedup.ts · 2u<br>**소유자**: @songmin<br>**Labels**: surface:core<br>**의존**: memory-dedup-planner, embedder-port, memory-eviction-planner, tier, sqlite-persistent-store<br>**UI**: cli<br>**Configurable**: integrated |

| 서브에이전트 — background task lifecycle + capability gating | TaskRegistry — background subagent registry + capability tokens + LRU | **L4** `[B]` | In-memory registry of background subagent tasks (v2's `taskRegistry` shape). Agent tool registers a task here when launched in background mode and resolves it when the forked runner settles; `task_output` / `task_stop` observe and cancel by id. Three seams: (1) `register()` returns the per-task `AbortController` — callers MUST plumb its `.signal` into the runner's request via `SubagentRequest.signal` so `stop(id)` actually unwinds the child (historical bug class fixed). (2) S17 capability token — `register()` returns an unforgeable `TaskOwnerToken` (128-bit `crypto.randomUUID()`) alongside the task id; the spawner stashes the token and surrenders it back to `stop(id, ownerToken)`. Without matching token, `stop()` REFUSES — a sibling subagent that learns another's `id` cannot DoS-cancel it. (3) LRU eviction — `maxRetained` cap (default 256) applies to SETTLED records only; running tasks never evict, never count toward the cap. Oldest-by-`endedAt` settled records evict first. Lives for the process — not persisted. Rules: pending → {in_progress \| cancelled \| blocked}; in_progress → {completed \| blocked \| cancelled}; blocked → {in_progress \| cancelled}; completed and cancelled are TERMINAL (no outgoing edges). Skills covered: - `babysit` — shepherd ONE PR from open→merged by reacting to CI failures and review comments in a loop (slogan: "merge when green"). - `fix-merge-conflicts` — resolve conflicts with BUILD-VALIDATED output; "resolved" only after the merged tree compiles AND tests pass. - `get-pr-comments` — turn a noisy review thread into a ranked, file:line- anchored action list without hallucinating reviewer priorities. - `loop-on-ci` — fetch failing-check logs, propose a MINIMAL fix per iteration, push, wait for re-run; smallest-diff discipline. - `make-pr-easy-to-review` — pre-review PR cleanup: detect the four canonical review-friction signals (noisy commits, stale description, unrelated files, mechanical+logic mix) and propose fixes. - `new-branch-and-pr` — end-to-end ship for a NEW change without bypassing Git posture rules (branch → stage → commit → push → PR URL). - `pr-review-canvas` — review with moved-code DETECTION so a function relocation is not misread as "delete + add" (the killer differentiator). - `review-and-ship` — composed ship loop: self-review (pr-review-canvas) + verify + commit + PR (new-branch-and-pr) in one orchestrated flow. The top-level `main().catch` in `apps/cli/index.ts` recognizes both `SessionStartupError` and `SessionBootstrapError`, logs `e.message`, and exits `e.exitCode` — so the user-visible behavior is still a clean exit-1 with a single diagnostic line, but the error flows through a typed throw instead of an inline `process.exit(1)`. Fills the gap that every modern agent leaves — Cursor's IDE panel, Claude Code session totals, Codex per-model OTel breakdown all emit unstructured logs but none expose a typed registry the operator can query in-process (`tool_calls_total`, `turn_duration_ms`, `verify_gate_pass_total`, …) AND export to an out-of-process collector with the SAME data model. Six explicit contracts: 1. PURE STORE — in-memory only, 0 I/O; the optional `MetricSink` is the only transport. With no sink, the registry is a snapshot-only primitive (Default-OFF posture per ADR-0144). 2. NAME COMMITS TO KIND on first use — `increment("foo")` after `gauge("foo", 5)` throws `MetricsError("name-mismatch-kind")`. Labels do NOT affect commitment — `foo{a=1}` and `foo{a=2}` share the kind. 3. SINK NO-THROW — `sink.send` wrapped in try/catch; a throwing sink logs nothing (observability plane must not crash the agent); the registry still records the sample. 4. NEGATIVE / NON-FINITE INPUT coerces to 0. Same posture as `BudgetMeter.tick`. 5. PERCENTILES via nearest-rank on a sorted ascending copy; empty sample → zeros. `histogramBuckets` reserved for a future bucketed-exposition adapter. 6. LABELS sorted lexicographically when forming the series key so `{a:1,b:2}` and `{b:2,a:1}` share one time-series. | LSP — stdio Content-Length framing | LSP JSON-RPC 2.0 codec — Content-Length framed (MessageReader / encodeMessage) | **L4** `[B]` | Wire-level codec behind `lsp-bridge` and `lspport`. LSP framing is NOT MCP's newline-delimited shape: every message is a JSON body preceded by an HTTP- style `Content-Length: N\r\n\r\n` header. The single hardest correctness risk in an LSP client is the stream framing — a server may flush several messages in one chunk OR split a single message (even its header) across many chunks. `MessageReader` owns a byte buffer and only emits a message once the full `Content-Length` body bytes have arrived, so partial reads AND coalesced messages are both handled. Closed `JsonRpcMessage` discriminated union — response (by `id`) vs notification/request (by `method`). `encodeMessage` writes a `Content-Length` header in bytes (not chars) so multi-byte UTF-8 payloads frame correctly. Companion of `mcp-client-jsonrpc` (newline-delimited variant) and `jsonrpc-envelope` (the standalone JSON-RPC 2.0 envelope SoT). · src/lsp/adapters/jsonrpc.ts, src/lsp/adapters/base.ts · ADR-15 · 1u<br>**소유자**: @songmin<br>**Labels**: surface:ipc · absorbed:codex<br>**의존**: mcp-client-jsonrpc, jsonrpc-envelope, lsp-bridge<br>**UI**: api<br>**Configurable**: partial |

| Unified Agent Runtime — 모드 매트릭스 dial 보정 (RFC may-22 §8.3) | clampDials — propositional dial clamping with operator log | **L2** `[B]` | Pure function `clampDials(dials, caps, onClamp?)` — for each of 16 dial fields, returns `min(requested, cap)` when both present; emits a `[budget-cap]` warn log via `@/shared#logger` for every clamp event (silent clamping is forbidden by the run-mode contract). Defensive normalization: NaN / ±Infinity / negative values are treated as absent rather than clamped to, so a config-poisoned cap can never silently disable a gate (BudgetMeter#tick `>` comparison would otherwise become NaN). Optional `onClamp(BudgetClampEvent)` callback for trajectory emission (independent of the log line). The terminal's scroll region is constrained to rows `[1..N-1]` so the last row is reserved exclusively for the status line — it is never scrolled out by stdout / streamed LLM output. Repaint protocol: SAVE_CURSOR → cursor-jump to bottom row → ERASE_LINE → paint text → RESTORE_CURSOR. Transient overlays (e.g. "Press Esc again to cancel") replace the default text and auto-revert after `transientMs`; the bar tracks the most recent default so a revert lands on the live state (not a stale snapshot). Three deliberate semantics: (1) NO-OVERRIDE — a key already set in the real environment wins; the file is only consulted for unset keys, so a CI / shell-exported override is never silently masked by a stale repo `.env`. (2) FIRST-WINS across files — earlier files in the array shadow later ones (`.env.dev` > `.env.local` > `.env`), matching the real precedence: the more-specific override wins. (3) `export ` prefix is stripped so a file that doubles as a shell `source` works unchanged (`export FOO=bar` parses key `FOO`, not `export FOO`). Cursor / Claude Desktop의 chat-inline collapsible panel과 달리 CLI의 풀-screen 점유는 곤란 — DECSTBM (DEC Set Top and Bottom Margins) ANSI escape를 활용해서 split-screen으로 위쪽 N 줄을 live timeline panel, 아래는 status bar + scrollback 영역으로 분할. Layout: 화면 행이 `rows`일 때 `rows-N..rows-1` 행이 timeline panel (ring- buffered N 행), 그 아래가 status bar (기존 layout), 그 위가 일반 scrollback. `QUANTA_TIMELINE` env가 unset / `0` / non-finite / non-TTY이면 panel은 **0 행** (disabled) → pre-timeline build와 visually indistinguishable. `createTimelinePanel({ height, write?, stream? })`로 panel + AgentEvent → 1-line stringifier (`renderTimelineRow`) 한꺼번에 build. 각 행은 짧고 forward-compatible — 미지의 AgentEvent variant도 throw 없이 generic fallback (timeline은 forward-compat plane). Write sink 오류는 SWALLOWED (UX surface는 절대 agent loop 못 무너뜨림). Turn N부터 뭐가 일어났어?" — 에 답하는 게 `/replay`. 세션 JSONL envelope이 이미 모든 trajectory를 deterministic order로 persist하고 있으므로 그걸 시간순으로 pretty-paint하는 surface만 추가. `/replay <session-id> [--at N] [--from tc_x] [--pace ms]` ship: (1) 세션 envelope iterator를 file-order로 traverse, (2) `--at N` flag로 turn N부터 시작 (skip first N-1 turns), (3) `--from tc_x` flag로 specific tool-call id 도달부터 시작, (4) `--pace <ms>` (default 0 = instant)로 row emit pacing 옵션, (5) live `/debug` consumer가 보는 것과 같은 single-line pretty format으로 stderr write — debug-tracer category filter도 동일하게 apply 가능. Determinism: file-order traverse + 동일한 pretty stringifier 사용 → 같은 세션 + 같은 flag 조합 = 같은 출력 (replay determinism). pacing은 rendering side concern (data side는 deterministic 유지). Live `/debug`와 surface parity: 같은 `renderTimelineRow` / debug-tracer category mapper 재사용 → 사용자가 live trace 보던 mental model 그대로 사후에도 적용. session-id resolution은 session-id store / state 디렉토리 스캔. ## 잔류 deliberate-boundary

- **Plan-queue — mid-turn user input capture/replay (Codex absorption)** (L3) — No consumer is wired today — mid-turn keystroke capture in the CLI / typed-while-running editor is a follow-up. → Wire the CLI key handler to call `enqueue` on Enter mid-turn; the loop calls `drain` at turn close.
- **CLI REPL GodClass → SOLID split (abandoned in-place; orphan tree pruned)** (L2) — SOLID restore deferred to a future slice that can atomically delete the
repl.ts inlined duplicates AND re-extract them. Splitting extract+migrate
is what produced the orphan tree pruned in Slice B (2026-05-25).
- **N-phase HITL state machine (plan-exit-flow 일반화)** (L3) — AgentConfig 와이어는 의도적 보류 — 첫 호스트(CLI repl 또는 IDE)가 driver를
소비할 때 별도 ADR로 와이어. default-OFF 보존. → Documented in ADR; wire when ROI concrete.
- **Playbook nesting — bounded recursive call chain with cycle detection — ADR-0258** (L4) — host wire 보류: auto-dispatch.ts / 어떤 planning surface도 아직 NestedPlaybookExecutor를
construct 안 함. 현재 라운드는 슬라이스 primitive만 (closed port + default
adapter + cycle helper + 15-case hellgate). 후속:
  - host adapter — procedure step "run playbook X" 디스패치 시 executor 주입
  - async sibling adapter — 자식 playbook이 subagent spawn 등 async 필요할 때
  - planner integration — DAG planner가 nested call을 시각화 / cost cap → Documented in ADR; wire when ROI concrete.
- **GitBudget — 5-knob wall-time / commit-count / output-size cap (ADR-0107)** (L4) — targetDurationMs / consecutiveOverBudget enforcement is forward-compat — caller-tracked today, no loop-level breaker. → Future: wire consecutiveOverBudget into a typed breaker once a multi-run aggregator slice exists.
- **web_fetch + web_search — HTTPS read-only + provider-gated search (ADR-0127)** (L4) — DNS-resolution-aware SSRF verification is a future ADR — today the deny is literal-host only (matches Claude Code WebFetch parity). → Add DNS resolve + post-resolve range check when a follow-up ADR justifies the additional latency.
- **request_plan_exit — model-driven plan-mode exit with 3-way outcome (ADR-0086)** (L4) — Auto within-run plan-mode transition needs a loop hook — deliberate follow-up (ADR-0086 §LIMITATIONS). → Add loop-level mode-flip seam when a cross-tool transition signal is required.
- **xlsx_read — typed stub awaiting deps decision (ADR-0137)** (L2) — Deps decision pending: SheetJS (~10 MB native binding) vs alternative
pure-TS xlsx parsers. Surface frozen now so the impl can be swapped
without breaking callers. → Land the deps decision, wire the parser behind the same surface, swap
the typed stub envelope for real output, lift maturity to L4.
- **ADR-0230 Realtime WebSocket — 8-method port (Codex streaming)** (L1) — Actual WebRTC media handoff + real audio encode/decode 후속 슬라이스.
SDP는 text-level negotiation만, audio-codec은 marker만. → Follow-up: WebRTC RTCPeerConnection adapter + Opus encoder/decoder
+ voice slice (ADR-0202/0208)과 통합.
- **ADR-0231 Radar Cards — background proposal queue MVP (Claude CoworkRadar)** (L1) — Full heuristic suite + UI 통합 + OTel engagement signal emit 후속.
MVP는 engine + port + adapter + 1 sample heuristic만. → Follow-up: 추가 heuristic (long-running task / idle-stuck / branch-stale 등)
+ UI surface (CLI banner + desktop panel) + engagement OTel emit
(`quanta.radar.engagement` metric).
- **Node REPL persistent kernel — Jupyter-style per-session node process** (L2) — - full Jupyter protocol envelope (msg_id / parent_header / metadata) —

- **Production DeferredResultRegistry — registry-managed deferred work (ADR-0286)** (L4) — Sqlite persistence for cross-restart deferred 후속 → Stage1 sqlite store와 동형 pattern (sibling SqliteDeferredResultRegistry under same port)
- **Async tool kind + poll_deferred — defineToolAsync + LLM probe (ADR-0287)** (L4) — Sqlite persistence for cross-restart deferred 후속 → Stage1 sqlite store와 동형 pattern (registry behind same port)
- **rememberPatterns — 권한 패턴 학습 + cascade 자동해소** (L3) — 모델-facing schema 미배선 — `rememberPatterns` / `isMaybeDangerous`는
dispatch seam이 action에 plumb만 하고, LLM tool/schema 계약에는 아직
노출되지 않음 (src/agent/admissibility-gate.ts의 acknowledged TODO,
src/permission/gate-pattern-wire.ts `grantAndCascade` deliberate hold).
coverage-gated cascade는 동작하지만 모델이 자가 제안할 수 없음. → 1) Tool 계약에 rememberPatterns/isMaybeDangerous output 필드 추가
   (defineTool out-schema 확장, ADR-0060 path).
2) 모델이 채워 보낸 값을 admissibility action surface로 통과.
3) end-to-end cascade test (모델 제안 → store grant → 두 번째 호출
   auto-pass) 추가 후 L4 재승격.
- **ConfirmDecision deny_and_steer verb — typed third option with steer injection** (L4) — Loop consumer for `steerInjection` is not yet wired into the next-turn prompt — the field is emitted on DispatchResult but the agent loop does not yet fold it into the model input. The 4 partial-wiring file-grep guards pin this state explicitly. → When the loop consumer lands (one-liner fold into the next prompt), update the G-1~G-1d guards consciously and the entry can promote to L5.
- **trust-scope persistent grant store — cascade + TTL (L3→L4 promotion)** (L4) — OS-keyring encryption-at-rest is a follow-up — the on-disk file is plaintext today (acceptable for the local-dev posture; remote / multi-tenant introduces a different trust model). → Wire keyring port when a hosted-agent or multi-tenant scenario lands.
- **pattern-grant auto-pass — admissibility-gate cascade (ADR-0061 wire-up)** (L4) — `grantAndCascade`의 dispatch-cascade 후속 와이어링은 모델-facing pending-
permission surface가 아직 노출되지 않아 보류 — 모듈은 `pending` queue를
optional로 받아 결과 ids를 반환만 함 (gate-pattern-wire.ts L120-126
deliberate hold). 핵심 `autoPassByPatterns` 술어는 admissibility-gate에
완전 배선됨. → 61-permission-remember-patterns의 promotion path와 묶임 — 모델 surface가
rememberPatterns를 출력하면 dispatch-cascade가 닫힘.
- **ADR-0044 negative invariants — single doc SSOT for 12 deliberately-not-absorbed patterns** (L2) — Doc-only by design — the ADR is the convention SSOT. Per-N runtime enforcement, where it exists, is registered separately (e.g. migration-importer-credential-read-ban for N10, web-fetch-search HTTPS-only for N11, persona-slot byte-identical default for N4). → L3 → L4 when ≥80% of N-items have a registered runtime-enforcement companion entry pointing to the actual gate.
- **External-agent importer — N10 credential-read ban (auth.json never opened)** (L4) — Credential migration is permanently out of scope — a separate ADR (with explicit user-consent UX) would be required to reverse N10. → No promotion path by design. Reversing the invariant requires superseding ADR-0044 N10 with a new ADR + dedicated security review.
- **Permission recorder — observability fail-open invariant (verdict cannot be flipped by emitter throw)** (L2) — No knob inverts this — the swallow is structural. A "loud emit" mode would couple verdict to telemetry health, defeating the invariant. → N/A — invariant is the goal state.
- **Bridge Attestation — remote permission preflight + STS token (ADR-0246)** (L3) — Network protocol (gRPC / WebSocket / Tauri IPC channel) is out of scope —
this slice produces tokens; transport is the caller's choice. JWT / JWKS /
asymmetric signing migration is a future ADR; current HMAC is symmetric for
round-trip simplicity. OS-keyring secret backend mirrors ADR-0050's deferred
OS-keyring path. Cross-process token cache (multi-process replay protection)
is future work. → L4 = first real caller wires the port (a Tauri sidecar bridge wrapper, an
org-policy proxy, or an MCP `bridge_attest_preflight` tool) + the 9-event
stream gets a downstream subscriber (jsonl recorder or OTel sink).
- **JWKS agent identity — remote JWK fetch + cache + verify (ADR-0248)** (L4) — Verify-only foundation. Signing (private-key custody — file/HSM/keychain
결정 필요), Cloud Tasks callback 통합, realtime/SSE auth wire 는 후속
슬라이스. 본 ADR 은 consumer 반쪽 (외부 발급 token 검증) 만 ship. → 1) agent-task registrar 가 `JwksClient` 주입받아 외부 dispatcher 응답
   토큰 검증 후 follow-up enqueue (composition-root opt-in).
2) Realtime/SSE 경로가 connection-auth 단계에서 verify 호출.
3) Signing 슬라이스 추가 시 동일 `JsonWebKey` 타입 재사용.
- **Multi-source rules vendor-detector (5-vendor convergence, ADR-0205)** (L3) — Wiring으로 @/agent/glob-rules.ts 합류는 별 슬라이스 — detector만 신설하고
loadGlobRules 합성은 후속. Default-OFF로 byte-identical 유지. → @/agent/glob-rules.ts:loadGlobRules가 createDefaultVendorDetector().detectAll()
호출해 결과를 기존 GlobRule[] 모양으로 어댑팅 + renderGlobRulesBlock 통합.
- **Per-tool granular checkpoint registry — in-memory ToolSnapshot store (ADR-0300)** (L3) — Slice provides the in-memory port + sibling T1 adapter factory only.
Two consumer slices are intentionally deferred so this lands small +
reviewable + default-OFF: (1) pre-tool-call auto-record hook on dispatch
(snapshots files the tool is about to mutate post-permission + the
messages array, then calls `granularRegistry.record(snap)`); (2)
`/rewind-tool` snapshot arm (extends the slash so `--mode=files|task|both`
restores the stored payloads directly via a separate `ctx.perToolCheckpointSnap`
slot, instead of routing through shadow-ODB). Both touch files outside
this slice's scope (dispatch.ts / rewind-tool-cmd.ts / slash-surface.ts)
and need their own ADRs. → 1) ADR-NNN — wire a pre-tool-call hook in `@/agent/dispatch` that reads
   the to-mutate file set via the FS port (post-permission, so denied
   tools pay no I/O) and snapshots into `ctx.granularRegistry?.record(...)`
   when wired.
2) ADR-NNN — extend `/rewind-tool` with a snapshot arm: when
   `ctx.perToolCheckpointSnap` is present, `--mode=files|task|both`
   resolves a toolCallId prefix and applies the stored payloads through
   surface-owned write paths.
3) Integration test asserting auto-record fires on every mutating tool
   and that `/rewind-tool <id> --mode=both --yes` restores both legs.
- **Pluggable Embedder + VectorStore provider registry (ADR-0261)** (L4) — Default-OFF — `loop`/`semantic`/`hybrid-query` does NOT consume the new registry. Existing ADR-0254 wiring is byte-identical. Plane-clean (no @/agent, @/memory, @/observability edits). → Wire a consumer (semantic.ts or hybrid-query.ts) to opt-in via createEmbedderFromEnv()/createStoreFromEnv(); add integration test; add metrics on embed-latency + query-latency.
- **Multi-modal embedding MVP — image + audio embedding port (ADR-0276)** (L4) — MVP intentionally LIMITED: locks the port shape + three adapters + 18-case
hellgate, but does NOT integrate with the retrieval pipeline. No vector
store consumes MM vectors. No semantic / hybrid-query / commit-embedder
edits. Default-OFF: no composition root imports the registry. Existing
ADR-0261 byte-identical. → Separate ADRs to follow:
  - real vector store columns for image/audio vectors (in-memory cosine
    works as-is; lance / qdrant need image/audio collection schemas);
  - retrieval pipeline integration (hybrid-query with modality filter);
  - dedicated audio embedding model (Whisper-hidden-state / CLAP) —
    the port shape is locked here, so a new adapter is the only delta.
- **SearchPipeline composer + 5 pre-built presets (ADR-0265)** (L4) — No automatic wiring into the dispatch loop, the agent assembly root, or
any surface. The composer is a leaf primitive — callers in @/agent
opt in by importing the sub-barrel explicitly and adapting their
concrete adapters (`LexicalSearchPort`, `SemanticIndex`, etc.) to the
inline duck-typed ports declared in `types.ts`. Cross-slice wiring is
a separate ADR. → Documented in ADR; wire when ROI concrete.
- **BudgetProbe — real wire of ADR-0138 ledger into ADR-0265 budget-aware preset (ADR-0274)** (L4) — No automatic wiring into the dispatch loop, the agent assembly root,
or any surface. Callers in @/agent opt in by constructing
`defaultBudgetLedger()` (ADR-0138), bridging its `totalCost` snapshot
to `{ totalUsd: ... }`, passing the bridged shape into
`createBudgetProbeFromLedger`, and feeding the result into
`budgetAwarePipeline` (ADR-0265). The bridge function lives at the
assembly site, not in this slice — keeps both ends slice-fence-clean. → Documented in ADR; wire when ROI concrete.
- **Pipeline composition-root wire — assemblePipeline(env) + search_codebase tool (ADR-0272)** (L4) — Production-grade semantic / embedder / reranker adapters remain

(auto-recall) is a separate ADR. → Promote when semantic/hybrid mode becomes default-safe for the main
CLI surface and the retrieval results feed a working-memory recall

line-window for code corpora (function-aligned chunks survive renames
and produce cleaner reranker inputs). We ship line-window first
because it is provably correct on every file type and adds no native
dependency.
